implementation_boundary.required: A surface and its source image share live pixel storage; a one-time copy is insufficient. Keep separate image/surface handles and retain storage while either referenced owner remains alive.
implementation_boundary.ordering: Current-surface drawing completes before the original context is restored and the temporary surface is destroyed.
implementation_boundary.no_guest_side_effects: This audit does not mutate QEMU, firmware, GUI flags, events or RAM.
implementation_boundary.limits: Actual null-attribute, format2,64x40 path is established. Additional attribute combinations, alternate image formats and non-current shared-context edge cases need their own support/validation, not silent success.

validation_level: Exact original static path plus actual API stop/image capture; no native GPU execution by this audit
